name: Uploadfic – Upload Any Mime Types
author: pluginfic

sections.description:
Uploadfic lets you enable unfiltered uploads in WordPress SVG, Excel, Docs, and more. Supports all MIME types easily and securely.

🔥 Features of Uploadfic

📁 Upload Any File Format – Effortlessly upload all file formats by selecting or adding custom MIME types.
🖼️ Modern Format Support – Full compatibility with SVG, EXE, ICO, JSON, HTML, and other popular file types.
🚫 Bypass Upload Limits ( New ⚡ ) – Override WordPress’s default restrictions without touching core files. It’s working based on the server configuration.
🧰 Zero Coding Needed – Intuitive interface designed for both beginners and advanced users.
🔐 Secure Upload Filtering – Built-in validation to block unsafe or unsupported file uploads.
➕ Custom MIME Type Control ( Coming Soon ) – Easily define and manage your own MIME types with just a few clicks.

🌟 Benefits of Uploadfic

✅ Unlock Restricted File Types – Enable uploads for file formats normally blocked by WordPress, like SVG, DOCX, EXE, and more.
✅ Save Time & Effort – No need for manual code edits or plugins for each file type—manage everything from one place.
✅ Boost Workflow Flexibility – Perfect for developers, designers, and content creators needing to upload a wide range of assets.
✅ Enhance Site Functionality – Expand what your WordPress site can handle by supporting more file types for media, tools, or documents.
✅ Improve File Management – Centralized control over all MIME types makes your media library more powerful and versatile.
✅ Stay Secure – Upload with confidence thanks to built-in checks that keep malicious files out.

📘 How to use ?

  • Navigate WordPress Dashboard to Uploadfic Menu.
  • Enable Your Preferred Mime Type & Click Save Button on the Header.
sections.installation:
1. Install Uploadfic by uploading the uploadfic zip file to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate Uploadfic through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
Can I upload svg?

Yes.

I need more help please!

Please use the support forum.

What file types can I upload to WordPress by default?

By default, WordPress only allows cetain types of files to be uploaded to a website for security reasons.

Can I Upload SVG to WordPress?

WordPress by default doesn’t allow uploading SVG files. Using Upload Any MIME Types plugin, you can now upload and use SVG files in WordPress.

Can I Upload HEIC to WordPress?

WordPress by default doesn’t allow uploading HEIC image files. This plugin unlocks compatibility so you can upload and display stunning HEIC photos with ease.

Will This Plugin Allow Custom Font Files Upload?

WordPress by default doesn’t allow uploading some font files like TTF, OTF, WOFF, EOT, and others. This plugin opens the gate to easy custom font upload.

Can I Upload APK Files to WordPress?

WordPress by default doesn’t allow uploading APK files. This plugin removes that barrier, letting you share Android app packages directly from your site.

Can I Upload Figma Files to WordPress?

WordPress by default doesn’t allow uploading Figma (.fig) files. With this plugin, you can upload design files just like images or documents.

Can I Upload GPX Files to WordPress?

WordPress by default doesn’t allow uploading GPX files. This plugin enables GPS file uploads so you can share maps, routes, and location data instantly.

Can I Upload EPUB Files to WordPress?

WordPress by default doesn’t allow uploading EPUB files. This plugin makes it simple to upload eBooks and digital publications in just a few clicks.

Help! I need support or have an issue.

Support is available for File Upload Types via the WordPress.org support forums.
